title: Common
description: Shared definitions reused across canonical beAIve records. Not emitted as a standalone record type.

coordinateFrame.description: TRD 2.1 coordinate frames: I=image pixels, C=camera, W=local AR world, B=body-centered skeleton, O=workstation object frame. Never equate B with a surveyed world location without a validated scale/reprojection check.

vector3.description: [x, y, z] in the frame named by the enclosing record's `frame` field.

measurementMethod.description: What produced the measurement (ADR-018). Only 'mediapipe_2d_image_plane' is implemented by the automated pipeline this phase; 'clinician_manual' and 'clinician_annotated' are for a reference-study or annotated value entered by a clinician; 'entered' is any other typed-in value; 'markerless_3d' is reserved for a future multi-camera pipeline and has no implementation (docs/adr/018-measurement-method-and-validation-strategy.md).

provenance.description: Per-record provenance so every event self-reports the versions that produced it (TRD traceability requirement).

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's own JSON Schema, e.g. "pose-landmark-frame/v0".

modelVersion.description: Identifier+version of the model/adapter that produced this record, e.g. "mediapipe-pose/0.10.9".

calibrationVersion.description: Identifier of the camera calibration record in effect when this record was produced.

metricsVersion.description: Version of the metric registry that computed the value, e.g. "metrics/v1".

referenceFileVersion.description: Version of the reference-range set used to classify the value.

clipSha256.description: SHA-256 of the clip the value was computed from.
